environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443. TLS terminated at the application via nginx reverse proxy. No application-layer inspection. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The SQLite database file is on an EBS volume mounted at /var/lib/app/. CloudWatch basic monitoring enabled for CPU/memory only.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener on port 443, target group health check on /health
config.compute: EC2 t3.medium, Amazon Linux 2, Docker container running Flask app
config.network: VPC public subnet, SG ingress 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0, egress all
config.tls: nginx terminates TLS, proxies to localhost:8080
config.monitoring: CloudWatch basic metrics, no request-level logging
